meta.name: add-vercel
meta.description: Add Vercel deployment capability to NanoClaw agents. Installs the Vercel CLI in agent containers and sets up OneCLI credential injection for api.vercel.com. Use when the user wants agents to deploy web applications to Vercel.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让智能体把网站部署到 Vercel
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想用智能体自动部署网站到 Vercel
copy.tagline_en: Let your agent deploy websites to Vercel
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your agent to automatically deploy websites to Vercel

howto.what: 装上后,NanoClaw agent 的容器里会安装 Vercel CLI,并由 OneCLI 自动注入 Vercel 凭证,从而能把 web 应用部署到 Vercel、列出部署、检查登录身份。
howto.when: 当你想让 agent 把 web 应用部署到 Vercel 时,它会接管;前提是 OneCLI 已可用,否则需先运行 /init-onecli 再重试。

say.text: 帮我把这个 web 应用部署到 Vercel 生产环境。
列出我 Vercel 上的所有部署。
say.note: 运行 vercel ls 查看部署列表

say.text: 检查一下 Vercel 当前的登录身份。
say.note: 运行 vercel whoami 确认认证

howto.what_en: Once installed, NanoClaw agents get the Vercel CLI inside their containers and OneCLI injects Vercel credentials automatically, so they can deploy web apps, list deployments, and check auth.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want an agent to deploy a web application to Vercel. OneCLI must be working first; otherwise run /init-onecli and retry.

say_en.text: Deploy this web app to Vercel production.
Check the current Vercel login identity.
